title: Royal Bank of Canada and Bank of Montreal agree to sell payments company Moneris to PE firm Francisco Partners for CA$2B in cash, splitting proceeds equally (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Royal Bank of Canada and Bank of Montreal agree to sell payments company Moneris to PE firm Francisco Partners for CA$2B in cash, splitting proceeds equally — Two of Canada's largest banks agreed to sell payments firm Moneris Solutions Corp. to Francisco Partners for C$2 billion ($1.4 billion) in cash.
